programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T3 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: John viaja até Orlando, Florida, e prova o brunch mais louco da sua vida - biscuits caseiros, bacon, ovos e massa com cinco tipos de queijo – tudo amontoado num só prato. Em Richmond, Vancouver, John vai até uma incrível deli judaica um pouco diferente, como os seus crepes judaicos que vão ter de ver para acreditar.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T3 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: John põe mãos à obra em Mississauga, Ontário, ao aprender a fazer as famosas chamuças de frango com manteiga que forma filas ao longo do quarteirão Em Tampa, Florida, John canaliza o chefe de churrasco que há em si e prova umas inovadoras criações de churrasco – incluindo o estaladiço e douradinho Deviled Pig recheado com carne de porco.

programme.title: Renovation Resort T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: As quatro cabanas de férias estão completamente transformadas e, para surpresa das equipas exaustas, ainda há um último desafio: o ancoradouro.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T3 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: A família Stoop quer adotar um cão para ser o companheiro do seu filho mais novo, o Tom. Ele tem de escolher entre um cruzado de Labrador retriever e border collie, um cruzado de collie e Labrador retriever e um cruzado de border collie e pastor alemão.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T3 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: A família Collins é visitada por três cães para adoção que esperam encontrar um lar. Vão ver um cruzado de pastor australiano, um cruzado de Terra Nova e um cruzado de Cairn terrier.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T6 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Scott revitaliza uma casa de férias que não é atualizada há vinte anos.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T6 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Scott moderniza uma antiga casa de férias em Muskoka e ajuda duas famílias a manterem o contacto.

programme.title: Aqui Há Mão T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Neste episódio, Fátima Lopes encontra-se com a designer Mariana Filipe, que transforma a tradição oleira em peças contemporâneas. Viajamos ainda até à olaria de Feliciano Agostinho, em Viana do Alentejo, onde este ofício ancestral se mantém vivo.

programme.title: Aqui Há Mão T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Nas ruas do Porto, fachadas antigas ganham vida com os painéis vibrantes de Joana Abreu, inspirados em azulejos. Já em Anadia, encontramos Agostinho Duarte, que mantém viva a tradição azulejar portuguesa, dando vida a painéis pintados à mão.

programme.title: Os Amigos Do Chef T2 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Beatriz Gosta não tem papas na língua. As suas histórias deixam o Chakall sem palavras e, com tantas experiências partilhadas num sotaque quase indecifrável, é fácil perder a concentração na cozinha.

programme.title: Personaliza A Tua Casa T1 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: No trabalho dos artesãos mais criativos Sofia Pereira encontra a inspiração para em cada episódio nos mostrar 3 propostas decorativas. Neste episódio – Vidro.

programme.title: Personaliza A Tua Casa T1 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: No trabalho dos artesãos mais criativos Sofia Pereira encontra a inspiração para em cada episódio nos mostrar 3 propostas decorativas. Neste episódio – Galos de Barcelos.

programme.title: Personaliza A Tua Casa T1 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: No trabalho dos artesãos mais criativos Sofia Pereira encontra a inspiração para em cada episódio nos mostrar 3 propostas decorativas. Neste episódio – Olaria.

programme.title: Renovation Resort T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Scott e Bryan trabalham em conjunto na margem, enquanto as equipas se dirigem para o salão, no terceiro desafio. Vão precisar de criatividade e mestria para conquistar a Construção Extra surpresa.

programme.title: Renovation Resort T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Scott e Bryan vão à pesca, enquanto as equipas trabalham no espaço discutivelmente mais importante numa casa de férias, a cozinha. Para aumentar a pressão, uma grande Construção Extra deixa as equipas em apuros.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Os proprietários Reesha e Duncan compraram uma cabana degradada à beira do lago para alugar e gerar renda para sua família em crescimento.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T3 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Construída no início dos anos 70, a casa de campo Muskoka do pai de Anita tem ossos fortes, mas está muito ultrapassada.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Em várias regiões de França, novos proprietários de elegantes, mas muitas vezes degradados, castelos e palácios, lançam-se na aventura de os restaurar e transformar em lares de sonho e negócios sustentáveis.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Em várias regiões de França, novos proprietários de elegantes, mas muitas vezes degradados, castelos e palácios, lançam-se na aventura de os restaurar e transformar em lares de sonho e negócios sustentáveis.

programme.title: Eco Reset - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Nas Hiide Cabins, Vera Kolodzig e Raminhos exploram um conceito de alojamento pensado para desacelerar, rodeado pela tranquilidade da natureza. Uma viagem ao Ribatejo para sair da rotina com humor, boa disposição e muitas gargalhadas.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T3 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: A família Higgins está à procura de um cachorrinho que se encaixe no seu estilo de vida divertido e ativo. Quem vai ter a palavra final na escolha entre o weimaraner, o terrier tibetano e o caniche miniatura?.

programme.title: Cães Com Tarefas Extraordinárias - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Revela o uso do olfato para a ciência. Equipas caninas no Canadá travam a invasão do mexilhão-zebra; no Cabo Ocidental, cães resgatam a rara tartaruga-geométrica; e um cão ajuda cientistas no mar a localizar fezes de orcas para monitorizar a saúde da espécie.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T2 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: John dirige-se até à cidade louca por brunch, Victoria, na Colúmbia Britânica, para provar o indulgente e super amontoado gofre de confit de pato de que toda a gente anda a falar.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T2 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: John mergulha na ementa do local de brunchs preferido de Montreal, no Quebeque, para devorar umas incríveis panquecas altíssimas e descobrir por que motivo este restaurante da nova escola judia está a tomar a cidade de assalto.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T2 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: John atira-se de cabeça na combinação italiana dos seus sonhos em Pittsburgh, na Pensilvânia: gnocchi caseiros fofos a nadar numa tigela de pão à moda de Sorrentina cheia de molho.

programme.title: Fire Masters T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: É uma batalha escaldante com três chefs a trazerem o seu melhor jogo de chamas para a Arena do “Fire Masters”. A Ronda Crossfire desperta uma grande criatividade e o banquete é uma fiesta ardente.

programme.title: Fire Masters T1 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Um prato de autor de inspiração internacional pega fogo ao sonho de ganhar a competição de um dos chefs. A Ronda Crossfire oferece uma oportunidade de pôr a conversa ao lume e os juízes desfrutam de banquetes gregos.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Inspirada na introdução dos pratos gourmet nos festivais de música em Portugal, Marlene Vieira promete recriar combinações improváveis nos tradicionais croquetes, rissóis e até chamuças. Fica para ver que não te vais arrepender!.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T1 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Em 2018, Marlene Vieira lançou um livro de Doces e neste episódio promete partilhar sugestões de sobremesas que te vão fazer querer comer e chorar por mais! Ah! E sem culpa… que estas não são light mas são na proporção certa!.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T4 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Neste episódio Verónica viaja até ao Uganda.

programme.title: Experiências.PT T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Neste episódio, vamos descobrir a capital do artesanato português e tesouros bem guardados como uma fábrica de chocolates, viver encontros improváveis com peregrinos a caminho de Santiago e descobrir por que é que Barcelos é a 'Meca' do hóquei patins.

programme.title: Experiências.PT T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: João desvenda a lenda romana que ficou impressa na história de Ponte de Lima. Nas águas do rio, o nosso viajante acompanha uma das promessas da canoagem nacional e internacional e, junto à margem, descobre a musicalidade das concertinas em uníssono.

programme.title: Eco Reset - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Na Madeira, Vera Kolodzig e Joana Seixas afastam-se dos roteiros habituais para conhecer uma ilha mais autêntica. Uma aventura marcada pelo contacto com a natureza e por experiências ligadas à terra e ao mar.

programme.title: Eco Reset - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Em Mafra, Vera Kolodzig e Mafalda Luís de Castro encontram um refúgio pensado para ser partilhado por toda a família, incluindo os companheiros de quatro patas. Um episódio dedicado ao bem-estar, ao descanso e à ligação com a natureza.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T2 - Ep. 30
programme.desc: A nossa viajante incansável Verónica Zumalacárregui volta ao Canal com novos episódios de “Comer Pelo Mundo”. Mais uma vez, pela sua mão, iremos conhecer a gastronomia autêntica de cada uma das cidades que visita. Neste episódio Verónica viaja até Macau.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Em várias regiões de França, novos proprietários de elegantes, mas muitas vezes degradados, castelos e palácios, lançam-se na aventura de os restaurar e transformar em lares de sonho e negócios sustentáveis.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T3 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: O especialista em imobiliário e empreiteiro Scott McGillivray oferece o melhor roteiro para a renovação e o sucesso do aluguer em Scott´s Vacation House Rules.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T3 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: O especialista em imobiliário e empreiteiro Scott McGillivray oferece o melhor roteiro para a renovação e o sucesso do aluguer em Scott´s Vacation House Rules.

programme.title: A Nossa Cozinha T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: A nossa cozinheira Maria José, uma alentejana de gema, traz-nos as melhores receitas dos pratos mais tradicionais portugueses, um programa cheio de tradição e simplicidade. Neste episódio aprenda a fazer - Bacalhau à Gomes de Sá e Arroz doce.

programme.title: A Nossa Cozinha T1 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: A nossa cozinheira Maria José, uma alentejana de gema, traz-nos as melhores receitas dos pratos mais tradicionais portugueses, um programa cheio de tradição e simplicidade. Neste episódio aprenda a fazer - Sopa da panela e Bochechas estufadas.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T3 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: John segue a magia até Orlando, Florida, para o 50º aniversário do Walt Disney World Resort e explora mais de 150 bebidas e comidas cheias de cor, encanto e sabor. John dirige-se até Toronto, Ontário, para uma aula em cozinha mexicana à base de plantas, incluindo um molho mole branco muito raro. Em Richmond, Vancouver, John vai descobrir o frango frito favorito da cidade, feito com alma pela Mama J.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T3 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: John viaja até à Filadélfia, Pensilvânia, até um local famoso pela sua comida de Guatemala, sobretudo as suas pupusas recheadas com queijo e, podem não acreditar, flores loroco. De seguida, John arregaça as mangas com o mestre da carne em Toronto, Ontário, onde aprende o segredo da sua famosa sanduíche de alce.

programme.title: Renovation Resort T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Scott e Bryan combinam trabalho o diversão, num paraíso para as quatro estações, ao darem início à segunda temporada de Renovation Resort.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T3 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: A família Mesly está à procura de um cachorrinho para completar a família feliz. Será que a mãe vai ter uma palavra a dizer, quando forem visitar o pug, o welsh terrier e o beagle?.

programme.title: The Point With Liu Xin
programme.desc: The Point with LIU Xin is a current affairs program on CGTN. The program comments on global news through LIU Xin's very own unique perspective.

programme.title: O Torneio
programme.desc: Numa cidade no norte de Inglaterra, um torneio é assistido por dezenas de homens ricos, com 30 concorrentes que estão dispostos a tudo para ganhar um prémio de 10 milhões de dólares. O objetivo é simples: matar todos os adversários e ser o último sobrevivente de todos.

programme.title: Zona De Perigo
programme.desc: Abby Trent é uma agente da CIA que gere uma prisão clandestina de alto risco. Quando capturam Hatchet, o homem mais perigoso do mundo e um mestre na arte da fuga, ele inicia um jogo sangrento, eliminando os oficiais um a um. Abby descobre que está rodeada de traidores. Em quem pode confiar?

programme.title: O Último A Cair
programme.desc: Após uma pandemia ter dizimado o mundo, o antigo soldado John Wood vive isolado numa floresta até lhe aparecer a pedir ajuda uma mulher ferida que parece ter o segredo para acabar com o vírus.

programme.title: Vem Ao Papá
programme.desc: Após receber uma carta enigmática do seu pai, que não vê desde os cinco anos, Norval viaja para ir ter com ele, na esperança de que esta seja uma oportunidade para se reaproximarem. Mas será que se ele soubesse a verdade sombria sobre o seu progenitor, ele o teria reencontrado?

programme.title: O Rio Do Desejo
programme.desc: Ao apaixonar-se pela misteriosa Anaíra, Dalberto passa a viver na casa que ele divide com os dois irmãos, nas margens do Rio Negro, na Amazónia. Mas quando Dalberto se ausenta para ir numa longa viagem, os desejos proibidos vêm à tona, com todos os irmãos a apaixonarem-se pela mesma mulher.

programme.title: Os Três Mosqueteiros
programme.desc: Ao lado de um jovem recruta ansioso por proteger o Rei de França, três leais espadachins tentam derrotar o pérfido conselheiro real e a sedutora espia enviada para derrubar a coroa.

programme.title: Uglydolls
programme.desc: Moxy é uma Ugly Doll que sonha com o dia em que encontrará a sua criança. Ela, e os seus amigos Wage, Babo e Ugly Bat, partem em busca do Instituto da Perfeição onde tudo farão para serem perfeitos. Mas esta aventura só os levará a perceber que o que nos faz únicos é sermos altamente… imperfeitos!

programme.title: Mavka A Alma Da Floresta
programme.desc: Mavka, a Alma da Floresta, é colocada perante uma escolha impossível entre o amor e o seu dever de Guardiã do Coração da Floresta ucraniana, quando se apaixona por um humano, um jovem e talentoso músico chamado Lucas.

programme.title: À Deriva
programme.desc: Quando Tami e Richard, um casal de ávidos velejadores, se aventuram numa viagem pelo oceano, são atingidos por um furacão devastador. Após a tempestade, ela encontra-o gravemente ferido e o barco quase destruído, e vai ter de encontrar as forças necessárias para os salvar.

programme.title: Os Estagiários
programme.desc: Billy e Nick são vendedores cujas carreiras foram destruídas pela era digital. Na tentativa de provar que não estão obsoletos, conseguem um cobiçado estágio na Google, juntamente com um batalhão de pequenos génios. O problema é que eles são quase info-excluídos…

programme.title: Jogo De Risco
programme.desc: Richie Furst financia as suas propinas da faculdade a jogar póquer na internet. Quando um dia é vigarizado, viaja até à Costa Rica para confrontar o responsável, Ivan Block, mas acaba por ser integrado na operação e viver uma vida de luxo, sem ter a noção do nível de ilegalidade que está a cometer.

programme.title: O Informador
programme.desc: Peter Koslow é um ex-soldado das Operações Especiais que é recrutado pelo FBI para se tornar informador e derrubar o maior senhor do crime de Nova Iorque. Quando a operação corre mal, ele fica preso entre a máfia, a polícia e o FBI — e terá de escapar para salvar a sua família.

programme.title: Moonfall Rota De Colisão
programme.desc: Uma força misteriosa tira a Lua da sua órbita em torno da Terra e envia-a numa rota de colisão capaz de aniquilar a vida como a conhecemos. Semanas antes do impacto, três heróis improváveis vão lançar-se numa última missão no espaço, e descobrem que a nossa Lua não é o que pensávamos que era.

programme.title: Machete Mata
programme.desc: O governo dos EUA recruta Machete para uma missão no México para deter um revolucionário psicopata que quer lançar um míssil nuclear em Washington.

programme.title: Sucker Punch - Mundo Surreal
programme.desc: Uma jovem é internada num hospício contra a sua vontade. Como estratégia para lidar com tudo, ela recua para uma extravagante realidade alternativa onde se junta a quatro prisioneiras que se tornam guerreiras experientes com a missão de recolher os quatro itens que lhes permitam fugir.

programme.title: Impacto Súbito
programme.desc: Quando uma mulher exerce uma vingança mortal nos agressores que a violaram e à irmã 10 anos antes, matando-os um a um, o inspetor 'Dirty' Harry Callahan é chamado para investigar e resolver o caso.

programme.title: Tom of Finland
programme.desc: A vida e obra do artista finlandês Touko Valio Laaksonen, mais conhecido como Tom of Finland, uma das figuras mais influentes e celebradas da cultura gay do século XX, desde o seu regresso a casa após lutar na Segunda Guerra Mundial até à sua consagração por via dos seus desenhos homoeróticos.

programme.title: Edge Of Fear
programme.desc: Após ter sido esfaqueado e deixado como morto, um homem tenta fazer o impossível: apesar de fraco, sozinho e com uma faca espetada no peito, terá de salvar a mulher dos assassinos que lhes invadiram a casa antes de sangrar até à morte.

programme.title: Respect
programme.desc: De criança que cantava no coro da igreja onde o pai era pastor até ao reconhecimento internacional, “Respect” acompanha a notável história de vida da cantora e compositora norte-americana Aretha Franklin e a jornada que efetuou para encontrar sua voz.

programme.title: O Pai Tirano
programme.desc: Chico ama Tatão, que é cortejada por Artur. Por seu turno, Graça ama Chico mas não sabe que ele ama Tatão. Santana escreve uma peça para os Grandelinhas que servirá de guião à paixão de Chico e convencerá Tatão de que ele é um rico conde. Mas nada vai acontecer como previsto.

programme.title: Robinson Crusoé
programme.desc: Numa pequena ilha paradisíaca, o papagaio Terça-feira e o seu grupo de animais amigos encontram o náufrago Robinson Crusoé. No início, o convívio não é fácil mas lentamente, todos começam a viver juntos em harmonia, pelo menos até dois gatos virem colocar tudo em risco.

programme.title: Antes Do Adeus
programme.desc: Nick e Brooke são dois estranhos retidos em Manhattan durante a noite, que vão gradualmente tornar-se confidentes um do outro. À medida que as horas passam, o inesperado acontece e eles acabam por ser forçados a confrontar os seus medos e assumir o controlo das suas vidas.

programme.title: A Modista
programme.desc: Quando Tilly regressa a casa, numa pequena cidade rural australiana, vai reconciliar-se com a mãe doente e vai recorrer à sua experiência na alta costura para transformar as mulheres locais e vingar-se de quem antes lhe tinha feito mal.

programme.title: Space Jam: Uma Nova Era
programme.desc: Quando LeBron James e o seu filho Dom são aprisionados numa realidade digital por uma Inteligência Artificial, o campeão da NBA terá de os fazer regressar salvos a casa, liderando Bugs, Lola Bunny e todo o gangue dos Looney Tunes numa vitória num jogo de basquetebol como nunca se viu.

programme.title: Hércules - A Lenda Começa
programme.desc: Em 1200 a.C, na Grécia Antiga, o príncipe Hércules desconhece que é filho de Zeus e só deseja o amor da Princesa de Creta, prometida em casamento ao seu irmão. Agora, ele vai ter de fazer uma escolha: fugir com o seu verdadeiro amor ou cumprir o seu destino e tornar-se o grande herói do seu tempo.

programme.title: Força Da Natureza
programme.desc: Uma quadrilha de ladrões planeia um assalto num velho complexo de apartamentos de Porto Rico quando um grande furacão se abate sobre o local. Mas a tarefa vai ser complicada por um polícia que lá está destacado para evacuar o local e um ex-polícia ansioso por voltar ao ativo.

programme.title: Cidade Dividida
programme.desc: Na cidade de Nova Iorque, Billy Taggart, um ex-polícia caído em desgraça trabalha como investigador particular e é contratado pelo presidente da câmara de Nova Iorque, a quem deve um enorme favor, para espiar a sua mulher.

programme.title: As Pequenas Coisas
programme.desc: Em Los Angeles, no início dos anos 90, dois detetives investigam uma série de crimes violentos, num processo complexo que os leva até um estranho solitário que poderá ser o assassino.

programme.title: Underworld - O Submundo
programme.desc: Numa guerra que dura há séculos, os vampiros e lobisomens lutam pela supremacia do Submundo longe do olhar dos humanos. Mas agora os lobisomens planeiam raptar um jovem médico humano para criar uma nova e invencível espécie. Apenas Selene, uma guerreira vampira, pode impedir este plano.

programme.title: Ratazana Assassina
programme.desc: Brody é um ranger que se prepara para abrir um novo parque de campismo, com a ajuda dos sobrinhos. Tudo parece estar em ordem até que uma ratazana gigante, que sofreu uma mutação devido aos resíduos tóxicos, começar a matar tudo o que lhe aparece à frente.

programme.title: Donizetti - Lucia di Lammermoor
programme.desc: Italian conductor Speranza Scappucci leads the Philharmonia Zürich and the Chorus of the Opernhaus Zürich in a performance of Gaetano Donizetti’s tragic opera ‘Lucia di Lammermoor’ (1835). Salvatore Cammarano based his libretto on Sir Walter Scott’s novel ‘The Bride of Lammermoor’ (1819). Set in 17th century Scotland, the opera tells the story of Lucia, who falls in love with Edgardo, her family’s arch enemy.

programme.title: Israel Philharmonic Orchestra: 60th Anniversary
programme.desc: In 1996, the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra celebrated its 60th anniversary with a gala led by maestros Zubin Mehta and Daniel Barenboim. This musical event features world-renowned soloists, including veteran violinist Isaac Stern, up-and-coming musicians Maxim Vengerov and Gil Shaham, as well as Pinchas Zukerman, Shlomo Mintz, and Itzhak Perlman. The evening begins with a moving speech about the early days of the orchestra.

programme.title: England, my England - I
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht focused on England, my England. On the basis of the festival theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer in a two-part documentary on an intriguing journey through England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60. Count Franz von Oppersdorff adored Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 and offered the composer a large sum to write a similar work. Beethoven obliged and completed his Symphony No. 4 in the autumn of 1806.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 1. Op. 1
programme.desc: Piano soloist Boris Berezovsky is accompanied by the Moscow Philharmonic Orchestra under the baton of Alexander Sladkovsky in a performance of Sergei Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto no. 1, Op. 1. Rachmaninov composed his first concerto while studying at the Moscow Conservatory at the age of 18. The concert opens with 'Heavenly Movement', a composition by the young Russian composer Elmir Nizamov (*1986).

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Septet in E-flat major - Opus 20
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is an orchestra based in Berlin, Germany and is ranked as one of the best orchestras in the world. In 1991, orchestra members played beautiful chamber music, such as Beethoven’s Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20. Beethoven finished his septet in 1800 and dedicated his work to Empress Maria Theresa of Naples and Sicily.

programme.title: Bach - Violin Sonata No. 3 (BWV 1005)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging piece. This performance was recorded at St.

programme.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin’s symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928).

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret?

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 5, KV 283
programme.desc: Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5, KV. 283. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Chamber Symphony Op. 110a
programme.desc: The Casco Phil, The Chamber Music Orchestra of Belgium, conducted by Benjamin Haemhouts, performs Shostakovich’s Chamber Symphony, Op. 110a. The work is a transcription by Rudolf Barshai of Shostakovich’s String Quartet No. 8, which was composed in only three days (July 12 to 14 1960). The work draws from Shostakovich’s pieces, like the Symphonies No. 1 and 5, and a Jewish theme from Piano Trio No. 2.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In September 2016, we celebrated the birthday of one of Japan's best-known conductors: Seiji Ozawa. Renowned for his advocacy of modern composers, Ozawa founded the Saito Kinen Festival Matsumoto in 1992. As of 2015, it is better known as the Seiji Ozawa Festival. Seiji Ozawa appeared on stage himself with 63 Saito Kinen Orchestra members, passionately conducting Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 and No. 7.

programme.title: Works for violin and piano by Corelli, Ravel a.o.
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform an intimate recital recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan. On the program are Arcangelo Corelli’s Violin Sonata in D minor, Op. 5 No. 12, “La Folia”; Ludwig van Beethoven’s Violin Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, Op. 73
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. Popularly known as the Emperor Concerto and composed in Vienna between 1809 and 1811, Piano Concerto No. 5 is Beethoven’s last completed piano concerto and often performed by star pianists such as Daniel Barenboim.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt.

programme.title: Handel - Messiah, HWV 56
programme.desc: The Messiah (HWV 56) by Georg Frederich Handel, also known as “A New Sacred Oratorio”, tells the life and suffering of Christ: a story of passion, fire, and sacrifice. This is one of Handel's best-known works, which took only three weeks to compose this oratorio and its famous 'Hallelujah'. The work has immense popularity since its premiere in Dublin in 1742, and is often presented at Easter.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw (2020)
programme.desc: Misha Fomin performed romantic piano works at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in November 2020. His recital opened with Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 10, Op. 14/2 and Sonata No. 15, Op. 28 'Pastoral'. He continued the program with a performance of Frédéric Chopin's Nocturne Op. 9/1, Etude Op. 25/7, and Johannes Brahms's technically demanding 'Variations on a Theme by Paganini', Op. 35 (Book II).

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final II: Mozart and Bartók
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 8, Op. 88
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world’s finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo’s magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák’s Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber’s Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn (*1979).

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 9, a profoundly emotional and technically complex work from 1909-1910, is characterized by its sprawling, late-Romantic style, exploring themes of human experience, love, and existential questions against the backdrop of Mahler's own impending death.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Intro and Rondo Capriccioso, Op. 28
programme.desc: The Waldbühne in Berlin, one of the most appealing outdoor amphitheatres on the European continent, is the home of the Berliner Philharmoniker’s summer concerts. With over 22.000 in attendance, they are some of the most popular classical music concerts in the world.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt.

programme.title: The Babylon Hotel
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world.

programme.title: Verdi - Messa da Requiem
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini.

programme.title: Legato - World of the Piano
programme.desc: We live in a 'renaissance of the piano”, as the New York Times has recently put it. With virtuosic flair and an eagerness to expand the repertoire, a new generation of pianists has revitalized the instrument’s appeal. In addition to the usual classics, they perform formerly scorned works or discover neglected composers.

programme.title: Memory of a Concert
programme.desc: In 2006, Gidon Kremer and Martha Argerich set out on tour performing solos and duets by Bartók und Schumann. The last of the concert series at the Berliner Philharmonie has been recorded for this film, featuring a rare solo performance by Martha Argerich. A concert film with personal and moving commentary by Gidon Kremer. Program: Schumann's Violin Sonata No. 1, Op. 10, Violin Sonata No. 2, Op. 121; Kinderszenen, Op.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final I: Chopin and Scriabin
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 35, K. 385
programme.desc: Claudio Abbado conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Mozart’s “Haffner” Symphony No. 35, K. 385, recorded during the very first Europakonzert in the Smetana Hall in Prague, 1991. Mozart originally composed the symphony as a serenade for the family of Sigmund Haffner, a childhood friend from Salzburg in 1782.

programme.title: Mussorgsky - Night on Bald Mountain
programme.desc: Young Euro Classic is the world’s most important platform for international young orchestra musicians in the European classical music tradition, and for its development. For 17 days every summer, orchestras from all over the world perform at Berlin’s Konzerthaus, on Gendarmenmarkt. This performance features some highlights of the Young Euro Classic edition of 2016.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1 And Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. The celebrated pianist performs this signature piece at the Lucerne Festival with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who makes his festival debut with the orchestra. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire.

programme.title: Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 30, Op. 109
programme.desc: Can we get into Beethoven’s creative mind, especially in the last phase of his life, when he was coping with severe hearing loss? Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Da Caserta and Filipotti - Dulcedo et Subtilitas
programme.desc: Filippotto and Antonello da Caserta were the first Neapolitan composers whose music was preserved. It is anything but primitive: these two belong amongst the prominent representatives of ars subtilior and the melodic Italian style which musicologist Nino Pirrotta christened “dulcedo.

programme.title: Hearing the Silence
programme.desc: Claudio Abbado was one of the world's finest and most-respected conductors. He held the post of musical director with La Scala in Milan from 1968 to 1986, with the Vienna Opera from 1986 to 1991, and the Berlin Philharmonic from 1989 to 2002.

programme.title: Johan de Meij - Symphony No. 1 “Lord of the Rings”
programme.desc: This concert is the result of the collaboration between the “Giuseppe Nicolini,” Conservatory of Piacenza, and the “Giuseppe Verdi,” Conservatory of Milan, as part of the project 'MIlanoPIACEnza ... suonare insieme”. On the program are works by the Dutch conductor and composer Johan de Meij. His Symphony No. 1 for woodwind and brass orchestra is titled “Lord of the Rings” and is based on the famous trilogy by writer J. R. R Tolkien.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: Confusing as it may be: Ludwig van Beethoven’s Second Piano Concerto was in fact composed ten years prior to his First Piano Concerto. The cause of this mess lies with the composer himself: Beethoven held back the publication of what we know as the Second Piano Concerto until after that of the First Piano Concerto, so he could thoroughly review the piece.

programme.title: Rimsky-Korsakov - Tale of the Invisible City Suite
programme.desc: In this exquisite 2016 concert from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall, the Russian National Orchestra and star-pianist Boris Berezovsky are led by conductor Mikhail Pletnev in a performance of magnificent works by Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov. Winner of the 1990 International Tchaikovsky Competition in Moscow, Berezovsky interprets the works of Rimsky-Korsakov with a virtuosic power.

programme.title: Caresana, Ziani, Scarlatti - Settimana Santa
programme.desc: ‘True lovers of Italian music’ is how the musicians of the young ensemble L’Escadron volant de la Reine describe themselves. Their fascination with Naples resulted in a programme for Holy Week. A sonata by Ziani, a motet by Caresana and a dialogue by Nola embrace two ‘leçons de ténèbres’ by Alessandro Scarlatti. His Miserere and Sinfonia Terremoto provide the turbulent final note.

programme.title: A Mozart Concert from Berlin
programme.desc: The Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach Chamber Orchestra delivers a program entirely devoted to Mozart at the Konzerthaus in Berlin under the direction of Hartmut Haenchen. In reduced form, the ensemble manages to bring to life the many characteristics of the music and the unique spirit of the famous composer, be it his gaiety of heart, his lyricism, his dramatic side or his polyphonic writing inspired.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, the Octopus Symphonic Choir, and four vocal soloists in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125 at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland's best-known orchestras. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Festive Mozart Concert from Salzburg
programme.desc: This performance was recorded during Mozart Week on January 27, 2006 in Salzburg, Austria, at the Großes Festspielhaus (Large Festival House) in celebration of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's 250th birthday. Under conductor Riccardo Muti, it features Thomas Hampson (baritone), Mitsuko Uchida (piano), Gidon Kremer (violin), Yuri Bashmet (viola), Wiener Singverein, and Wiener Philharmoniker. Pieces include Piano Concerto No.

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 14, Op. 131
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 7, Op. 70
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Antonín Dvorák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. The work was completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvorák’s broader oeuvre.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) and Chorus in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The soloists are Iwona Sobotka (soprano), Anna Stephany (mezzo-soprano), Robert Murray (tenor), and Florian Boesch (baritone).

programme.title: Tchaikovsky Symphony 2 And Elgar’s Enigma Variations
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final I: Liszt and Ravel
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Handel - The Triumph of Time and Truth
programme.desc: Emmanuelle Haim conducts Le Concert d’Astrée in a rendition of G. F. Handel’s two-part oratorio “Il Trionfo del Tempo e del Disinganno” (The Triumph of Time and Truth). The work with a libretto by Benedetto Pamphili was first performed in Rome, in 1707. Director Krzysztof Warlikowski has taken Handel’s first oratorio, written when the composer was only 22 years old, on in a deep, tender staging.

programme.title: Abbado conducts Mahler and Schönberg
programme.desc: The program is introduced with a short documentation about Schönberg's Pelleas et Melisande, based on a text by Claudio Abbado. Every musical theme relates to a special colour appearing on screen. What has been so remarkable about Abbado’s Mahler performances is that their impact has never been achieved at the expense of the multiple sensitivities, subtleties and extreme sophistication.

programme.title: The 12 Cellists - Documentary
programme.desc: Directed in 2012 by Enrique Sánchez Lansch, the documentary The 12 Cellists follows the 12 cellists of the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra. Since 1972, this group is a staple of the international musical universe. Whether they play classical music, jazz, tango or avant-garde music, these talented musicians invariably enthrall audiences with the wide range of unique and bewitching sounds they produce with their cellos.

programme.title: Liga D’Ouro - Ep. 174

programme.title: Minha Familia É Assim - 1ª Exibição
programme.desc: O “Minha Família é Assim” trata de assuntos relacionados com a família, desde a educação dos filhos até aos assuntos atuais que atingem as famílias. Baseado nos ensinamentos e nas orientações da Igreja, transpondo os valores cristãos.

programme.title: A Luz Da Fé - 1ª Exibição
programme.desc: O Programa A Luz da Fé tem como objetivo explorar e refletir os vários temas ligados à vivência da fé católica. O programa é apresentado em forma de temporadas, sendo elas temáticas e diversificadas. Um verdadeiro caminho de aprendizagem para quem quer viver sua fé à luz da Doutrina.

programme.title: Santo Terço - Mistérios Gloriosos BH - 1ª Exibição
programme.desc: No programa 'Santo Terço', os fiéis e missionários meditam o santo terço e contemplam os mistérios da vida de Jesus.

programme.title: Luz Para Os Meus Passos (Antigo Testamento) - 1ª Exibição
programme.desc: O programa Luz para os meus passos vai refletir sobre passagens bíblicas de difícil interpretação, no formato de perguntas e respostas, feitas por Frei Gilson e Dom Francisco Falcão, bispo auxiliar do Ordinariado Militar do Brasil.

programme.title: Gente De Fé
programme.desc: Histórias de confiança, superação e de esperança para gerar no coração do telespectador uma vida de fé..

programme.title: Estúdio Canção Nova - 1ª Exibição
programme.desc: Programa com o intuito de proporcionar uma experiência de fé a partir de videoclipes de cantores católicos.

programme.title: PHN
programme.desc: Com muita música e descontração, o programa traz histórias de quem assumiu o PHN “Por/hoje/não” e mudaram as suas vidas.

programme.title: Reinflama
programme.desc: O programa 'Reinflama' oferece momentos de oração e encontro com um Deus vivo e vivido através de oração, música e meditação da palavra de Deus..

programme.title: Documentário ACN
programme.desc: A Fundação Ajuda a Igreja que Sofre traz-nos as realidades externas, principalmente, as notícias do Médio Oriente.

programme.title: Terço Da Misericórdia
programme.desc: Recitação do terço da misericórdia e meditação de um parágrafo do diário de Santa Faustina.

programme.title: Som Do Monte
programme.desc: O programa Som do Monte semanalmente, apresentado por Frei Gilson, religioso do instituto Carmelitas Mensageiros do Espírito Santo. O programa tem como foco levar uma espiritualidade profunda e radical, através de fontes arraigadas à tradição da Igreja, vida dos santos, catecismo e palavra de Deus. Tudo isso somado a musicalidade e carisma próprio do Frei Gilson.

programme.desc: “Minha Terra, Minha Gente” apresenta o melhor dos 308 concelhos do território, através da tradição, da inovação e da sustentabilidade. programme.title: Feira Semanal: Caldas Da Rainha
programme.desc: Nas Caldas da Rainha, a feira é um mercado de cor, é frescura, é raiz. O centro da cidade enche-se de bancas repletas de fruta acabada de colher, legumes que ainda cheiram a terra e mãos sábias que conhecem cada estação do ano. Neste episódio do “Feira Semanal”, entramos numa feira muito antiga, onde quase tudo o que se vende, vem diretamente do campo.

Da manhã à noite, a câmara observa as rotinas, os gestos e os momentos mais banais ou marcantes do quotidiano, revelando vidas que podem ser surpreendentemente diferentes — ou profundamente semelhantes — à do espectador.

programme.title: Documentário: Chefe Do Ano 2026
programme.desc: Há 36 anos que a mesma pergunta atravessa as cozinhas de Portugal: quem é o Chefe do Ano? Mais do que um concurso, é o palco onde um sonho se transforma em legado, o mesmo que revelou nomes hoje incontornáveis na gastronomia portuguesa, todos eles, um dia, apenas cozinheiros e cozinheiras com uma faca, uma ideia e a coragem de arriscar tudo.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 82
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 78
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Vocal Acrobats: Passion of an Improvised Journey
programme.desc: One vocalist from Paris and the other from Bern, and two contrasting personalities. Brought together by a chance encounter in 2014, the two singers were surprised to discover how much they had in common: they both do more than just sing well. Leïla Martial and Andreas Schaerer intend to explore and experiment, stretching their vocal boundaries.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: Steven Delannoye
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Jazz a` Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: LBT - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. Among the artists of 2019 is the German Leo Betzl Trio.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard Quintet in Brussels, 1980
programme.desc: By the time this set was recorded at Brussels Jazz Club in the summer of 1980, trumpeter Freddie Hubbard had already built an impressive resume. During the 1960s he became a leading voice in the hard bop movement while not shying away from avant-garde sessions with the likes of John Coltrane and Eric Dolphy.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Burton And Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Kenny G - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, smooth jazz saxophonist and crowd-favorite Kenny G serenaded those attending the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Marion Williams Sings Spirituals
programme.desc: You can’t help but be carried away by the powerful voice Marion Williams, who, with backing from Tommy Brown (piano), Joe Washington (organ), Billy Tuliver (drums), and singers Barbara White and Ann Bolden, sings gospel songs and spirituals as if she has lived them a thousand times over. The repertoire includes such familiar tunes as “Peace in the Valley,” “We Shall Overcome,” and “Michael, Row the Boat Ashore.”.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Bertus Borgers And The Young Retro's
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2018, English trip-hop group Morcheeba performed at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Wolfert Brederode
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Sun Ra Arkestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1985, pianist and space-faring jazz icon Sun Ra and his Arkestra crash-landed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Orlando Julius
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist.

programme.title: Lorrèn at the North Sea Jazz Club: Shades of Blue
programme.desc: With her relaxed, bright voice, vocalist Lorrèn has made her name on the Dutch jazz scene. Lorrèn grew up in a family of music fans: from a very early age, she developed a fondness for the music of her great jazz heroine, Ella Fitzgerald. Also Selah Sue, Adele and Amy Winehouse influenced this wonderful soul, jazz, and pop singer. Lorrèn knows how to transport her audience to infinity with her contemporary music stamp.

programme.title: New Cool Collective - Melkweg, Amsterdam
programme.desc: New Cool Collective is one of the foremost Dutch jazz ensembles. Pioneering new blends of music styles since 1993, NCC has performed in various formations, from small combos to larger ensembles and even big bands! The ensemble’s high energy is cut out for the dance floors, as dance, Latin, salsa, afrobeat and boogaloo all meet in a jazzy mix.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Michel Legrand Orchestra at Spa, 1982
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024 interview - Oran - Open Arms
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.title: Brazilian NYE
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is the duo of Giana Viscardi and Gustavo Marques.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: I Will Not Be Sad
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival, held in Osnabrueck, has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. Jivan Gasparyan Jr has always been inspired by the folk melodies of his native Armenia.

programme.title: Be Good (Lion's Song)
programme.desc: Unlike many of his fellow jazz cats, vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble. After sustaining a shoulder injury, this former American football player turned to jazz singing. He was discovered in a Californian jazz club by pianist, saxophonist and composer Kamau Kenyatta. Porter lent his vocal skills to gospel choirs across the country and a string of successful musicals before turning his talent to his own compositions.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Sandro Schneebeli
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Arsenik - Olympia, Paris
programme.desc: The mythical duo Arsenik is a rap group from France, made up of two brothers, Lino and Calbo. The team performs at Olympia Paris to celebrate their 20 years since their first album, Quelques gouttes suffisent… It’s a unique concert: Arsenik plays the entire album with numerous special guests for the first time. The album has sold over 300,000 copies in France.

programme.title: Episode 3: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan.

programme.title: Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician. At the London jazz club Vortex in 2013 he impressively says his goodbyes to the international stage.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. The 2018 edition of WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: NSJ Vocal Selection: Carter, O'Day and Benjamin
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong: Live in Australia
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: jazzahead! 2023 interview
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Club: Marnix Busstra Band
programme.desc: Guitarist, composer and director Marnix Busstra loves crossing borders. He travels the world with his jazz bands, plays guitar and bouzouki, writes jazz and theatre-songs, and co-creates and directs the exuberant theatre shows of his wife, the Dutch diva Karin Bloemen. Busstra is a constant wheel of invention, with technique expanded by his creative urge to find something new, an evolving state that adds immeasurably to his art.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sia - Live at The Metro Theatre
programme.desc: The Australian-born singer-songwriter Sia Kate Isobelle Furler, simply known as Sia, is one of the most unique artists in today's popular music scene. However, her path to stardom has been nothing but rocky. Only after numerous musical experimentations, where the singer tried to establish herself in her home country as well as United Kingdom, Sia finally blossomed in United States around the second decade of the 21st century.

programme.title: Franco Ambrosetti Quintet live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The composer, trumpeter and bugle player Franco Ambrosetti performs with his quintet in his native Lugano as part of the Estival.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Badbadnotgood
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Where Are We Now - Part I
programme.desc: German jazz and cabaret singer Atrin Madani was born in 1998 as the son of Iranian immigrants. In the face of pandemic uncertainty, geopolitical upheaval, and social unrest in his ancestral home country, Madani asked himself: where are we now? His response to this question is as clear and precise as his singing: what we need most right now is honesty, humility, and quality.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2023 interview
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: My Funny Valentine
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Ella Fitzgerald - Antibes Jazz Festival
programme.desc: The 1964 edition of the Antibes Jazz Festival in Juan-les-Pins saw the return of the First Lady of Song, Ella Fitzgerald. Together with Roy Eldridge on trumpet, Tommy Flanagan on piano, Bill Yancey on double bass, and Gus Johnson on drums, the tireless singer performed such classics from the Great American songbook such as 'Them There Eyes', 'The Lady Is a Tramp', 'Summertime', 'I'm Putting all My Eggs in One Basket', 'St.

programme.title: Paradox Live: BRUUT!
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Blue Note: A Story of Modern Jazz - Part II
programme.desc: Art Blakey, Dexter Gordon, Ron Carter, Herbie Hancock, Thelonious Monk... these names are synonymous with the great Jazz Age. But how many people know Alfred Lion and Francis Wolff, to whom we owe the recorded memory of our Jazz legends? Two German Jews who emigrated from Nazi Germany to New York 'discovered' an American art form which at the time received little serious attention from mainstream America: Jazz Music.

programme.title: Classic Meets Jazz
programme.desc: Tzimon Barto, the young American classical pianist and Wolfgang Dauner, the internationally renowned German jazz pianist join their talents to show how multi-dimensional music can be.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - North Sea Jazz Part II
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Funk in Deep Freeze
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital’s central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano’s “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album.

programme.title: Songs She Never Heard
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: Great Guitarists - Collage
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: Mike Stern And Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat And Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis’ comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Bireli Lagrene
programme.desc: Biréli Lagrène is a French jazz guitarist born on September 4, 1966 in a family of gypsy tradition. His brother and his father introduced him from an early age to the repertoire of Django Reinhardt, whose influence is still felt in the style of Lagrène. In this performance, Lagrène pays homage to Django Reinhardt with his son, Babik Reinhardt.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Carlinhos Brown
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Live at Beck’s Festival Bar
programme.desc: The UK based band Metronomy started out as a bedroom project by Joseph Mount, who during its early stages was the sole contributor to the band's repertoire. After the debut release, Mount started expanding the band's personnel: first by adding two members, and later increasing it by one more.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Session: From Rossini to Piazzolla
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.
